headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.8
summary: This release adds an account session check and a clear instance cache option, while documentation now points to LeviLauncher and LeviLamina guides.

items.text: Add an account session check to the accounts screen.
Add a clear instance cache option to instance settings.
Point native mod documentation to LeviLamina's docs.
Remove the bundled docs site; documentation now lives in LeviLauncher's docs.
Align documentation setup with upstream LeviLauncher.
